content.short: Osmium DAO is a risk-managed investment community on Cardano that is governed by NFT and token holders.
content.description: Osmium DAO is a decentralized autonomous organization on Cardano focused on strategic, risk-managed investments and treasury growth. The protocol utilizes a unique governance structure where both OsmiumShare NFT holders and $OSM token holders collaborate to influence the DAO's direction. By pooling community resources, Osmium DAO aims to identify and support high-quality initiatives across the blockchain, sharing the benefits of its curated portfolio with active participants. The project emphasizes transparency and community-led decision-making for long-term ecosystem stability.
